session_init.budget_strategy: Economy mode (workspace default, AGENT.md principle model-economy) : - Orchestrator : high-tier (coordination) - Sub-agents : mid-tier first ; high-tier only for the cases listed in model-economy - Tool budget per agent : 25 tests / 30 refactor / 50 initial audit (AGENT.md agent-budget) - An agent that stalls : stop, partial report, re-brief with more context
session_init.skills_load: 1. skill-root (always first) 2. [CODE_STYLE_SKILL] for any code 3. [DOMAIN_SKILL] according to the project
session_init.context_paths: Workspace root : [WORKSPACE_ROOT] Project : [WORKSPACE_ROOT]/[PROJECT_PATH]/ Operator env : .claude/context/operator-env.md (names of variables and aliases, never values)
session_init.orchestration_rules: - etat-des-lieux and project-table at session start - task-completion-archive at task end - multi-agents-default for any task over 3 steps ; self-execution under 3 files / 6 steps - backlog-event-driven micro-writes - test-agile (blocker) : tests in the SAME session as the code - cross-platform (blocker) - git : agents prepare commands, the operator runs them - LOCK : diff, justification, explicit go, then application - nothing-deleted : moves to _to-delete/YYYY-MM-DD/
session_init.bootstrap: 1. Load the skills listed in skills_load. 2. Targeted grep (no full re-read) on : - [PROJECT_PATH]/AGENT.md (project section) - [PROJECT_PATH]/NEXT-STEPS.md - the last orchestrator log in .claude/logs/orchestrator/ 3. Report in 5 to 8 lines : state, anomalies, plan, request for validation. 4. After validation : create the session log .claude/logs/orchestrator/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-[sprint-slug].md
session_init.mission:
[DESCRIBE THE MISSION IN 3 TO 5 LINES]
Items : [LIST ITEMS WITH TAG [HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW] AND [AGENT PERSONA]]
session_init.execution_strategy: - Wave 1 : [X] mid-tier agents in parallel on [LIST], each brief ending with the mandatory-trace block - Checkpoint : build + tests (the operator runs anything that needs his machine) - Audit by an agent that did not write the code : GO / GO WITH CONDITIONS / NO-GO - Wave 2 if green : [Y] agents on tests / coverage
session_init.constraints: - No git write command run by an agent : exact commands prepared for the operator - No emoji in produced files - Code in English, discussion in [PRIMARY_LANGUAGE] - Cross-platform by default
session_init.session_end: 1. DASHBOARD : statuses and recent activity 2. claude-friendly backlog : event-driven updates 3. NEXT-STEPS : promote Next if Now is empty 4. Orchestrator log : agents launched = traces written (closure gate)
